blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Carl Tamayo expressed confidence in Gilas Pilipinas’ 12-man roster for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers, even as an injury setback keeps him out of the lineup. The Gilas forward remains sidelined after sustaining another injury while playing for the Changwon LG Sakers in the Korean Basketball League last November 1. He had previously sprained his ankle against Jordan in the previous window.
